entities.summary: Thoothukudi is a port industrial city in Thoothukudi district in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It lies on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal. The city is capital and headquarters of the district. According to the Confederation of Indian Industry, Thoothukudi has the second highest Human Development Index in Tamil Nadu, next to Chennai. Thoothukudi City serves as the headquarters of Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited, one of the leading private sector banks in India. Major educational establishments in the city include the Government Thoothukudi Medical College, Fisheries College and Research Institute, Tamil Nadu Maritime Academy, V.O.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Thoothukudi's significance lies in its role as a major port and industrial center in Tamil Nadu, contributing to the state's high Human Development Index. As the headquarters of Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited, it has played a crucial role in India's banking sector.
